description_en: Queries the blacklisted IP addresses for Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium instances
description_zh: 查询针对DDoS高防实例的黑名单IP
name: DescribeAutoCcBlacklist

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium instance.
You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/157459.html operation to query the IDs of all Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium instances
parameters.help_zh:
DDoS高防实例的ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/157459.html查询所有DDoS高防实例的ID信息
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The source of the blacklisted IP addresses to query. Valid values:
manual: Manually added.
auto: Automatically added
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的黑名单 IP 的来源。取值：
manual：手动添加。
auto：自动添加
parameters.name: query_type

parameters.help_en:
The prefix of the source IP address used for keyword-based queries.

The prefix must be more than three characters in length
parameters.help_zh:
使用源IP关键字查询，指定要查询的源IP的前缀。

必须大于3个字符
parameters.name: key_word

parameters.help_en: The page number to return for a paged query. For example, to query the first page, set the value to 1
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询请求时返回的页码。例如，查询第一页的返回结果，则填写1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page
parameters.name: page_size

AutoCcBlacklist.description_en: The list of blacklisted IP addresses for the Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium instance
AutoCcBlacklist.description_zh: 针对DDoS高防实例的黑名单IP列表

DestIp.description_en: The IP address of the Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium instance

EndTime.description_en: The expiration time of the blacklisted IP address. The value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds
EndTime.description_zh: 黑名单IP的失效时间。时间戳格式，单位：秒

Type.description_en:
The source of the blacklisted IP address. Valid values:
manual: Manually added.
auto: Automatically added
Type.description_zh:
黑名单IP的来源。取值：
manual：手动添加
auto：自动添加

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request. The ID is a unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request and can be used for troubleshooting
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of blacklisted IP addresses
